name: libsignal
comment: A stand-in for the npm package `libsignal`, which is GPL-3.0 and is the only
reason a binary containing the WhatsApp bridge is a combined work. Baileys
Everything here forwards to `whatsapp-rust-bridge` — MIT, published by the
Baileys organisation, already a dependency of Baileys and already used by its
utility layer. Baileys is mid-migration onto it; this finishes the last piece
ahead of upstream rather than reimplementing anything.
Declared, as everything this imports is: without it the import resolved only through the store's
hoisted fallback, which held the version Baileys happened to depend on. The pin is Baileys' own,
and wa-bridge-licence.test.ts holds the two together.
Named `libsignal` on purpose. Baileys imports the package by name in four
places, including three deep imports, and aliasing the name is what lets those
